findings.current: The four walls surrounding the city now stretched a full ten ri on each side—a length and breadth rarely seen even in the Central Plains.
findings.defect: The draft makes each side ten ri long rather than giving that length for the four walls together. It also omits their unusual strength.
findings.rationale: The source attributes the ten-ri length, sturdiness, and enclosed area to the four walls collectively; it does not say each side measures ten ri.
findings.replacement: The four walls surrounding Xining now ran a full ten ri in length, enclosing a vast area with a sturdiness rarely seen even in the Central Plains.
findings.source: 현재 서녕을 둘러싼 네 면의 성벽은 그 길이만 무려 십 리에 달하는, 중원에서도 쉽게 찾아볼 수 없는 굳건함과 광활한 면적을 갖추게 되었다.

findings.current: His Disciple was an impulsive fool, a thunderbolt with no sense of manners. But he was his one and only Disciple.
findings.defect: “A thunderbolt” turns a description of a reckless, ill-mannered brat into an image of speed or power.
findings.rationale: 천둥벌거숭이 characterizes Taekyung’s heedlessness, not his martial speed or force.
findings.replacement: His Disciple was a reckless brat who’d long since thrown manners out the window. But he was his one and only Disciple.
findings.source: 앞뒤 안 가리는 천둥벌거숭이에, 예의라고는 진즉 밥 말아 먹은 놈이지만 하나뿐인 제자다.

findings.current: Of course, his Disciple knew his Master too well for him to express that embarrassing concern directly.
findings.defect: The draft says Jeok cannot express his concern directly. The source says Taekyung knows him too well for an indirect expression to conceal it.
findings.rationale: 에둘러 표현하기에는 makes indirect expression the ineffective approach; the disciple’s understanding defeats it.
findings.replacement: Of course, Taekyung knew his Master far too well for Jeok Cheongang to hide that bashful concern behind roundabout words.
findings.source: 물론, 그 쑥스러운 마음을 에둘러 표현하기에는 그의 제자 역시 스승을 너무나도 잘 알고 있었지만.

findings.current: But when his Master had asked if he was still afraid of the enemy, his Disciple had nodded without hesitation, then added:
findings.defect: The paired “his Master” and “his Disciple” obscures who asked whom and can imply that Jeok’s own Master asked the question.
findings.rationale: Jeok is the Master asking; Taekyung is the Disciple who nods.
findings.replacement: But when Jeok Cheongang had asked Taekyung whether he was still afraid of the enemy, his Disciple had nodded without hesitation and added:
findings.source: 하지만 아직도 적이 두렵냐는 스승의 뒤이은 물음에, 망설임 없이 고개를 끄덕인 제자는 이렇게 덧붙였었다.

findings.defect: “Defiant” substitutes opposition for Taekyung’s assured composure.
findings.rationale: 당당했다 conveys confidence and resolve here, alongside 담담했다, rather than defiance toward the person questioning him.

summary: Five actionable findings: a wall-length error, two characterization or register shifts, and an ambiguous kinship reference.
